metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) over Los Angeles lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need tropospheric NO2 data. TROPOMI/Sentinel-5P provides this data with the 'NO2' band. 2. Time periods: Oct 1-23 for 2021, 2019, and 2018 3. Location: Los Angeles area - need to define a geometry 4. Masking: For NO2 data, we need to filter for quality using the 'qa_value' band 5. Logic: Compare mean NO2 values between years - if 2021 < 2019 AND 2021 < 2018, then answer A, else B For data quality: - Check collection size for each year - Check valid pixel count after quality filtering - Validate NO2 values are reasonable (not NaN, not extreme values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laBounds = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.7, 33.7, -117.9, 34.3]); // Los Angeles area // Define date ranges for comparison const dates = { '2018': ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-23'], '2019': ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-23'], '2021': ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-23'] }; // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing const results = {}; for (const [year, dateRange] of Object.entries(dates)) { // Get TROPOMI NO2 data with quality filtering let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filterBounds(laBounds); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log(`No data for ${year}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composite and mask low quality const meanImg = collection.mean(); // Check valid pixels const countStats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: laBounds, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = countStats.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${year}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 concentration const meanStats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laBounds, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNO2 = meanStats.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Mean NO2: ${meanNO2 ? meanNO2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); if (meanNO2 === null || meanNO2 === undefined || !isFinite(meanNO2)) { console.log(`Invalid calculation for ${year}`); console.log("C3"); return; } results[year] = meanNO2; } // 3. Comparison Logic console.log(`Comparison: 2021 (${results['2021'].toFixed(6)}) vs 2019 (${results['2019'].toFixed(6)}) vs 2018 (${results['2018'].toFixed(6)})`); // Check if 2021 is lower than both 2019 and 2018 const isLowerThan2019 = results['2021'] < results['2019']; const isLowerThan2018 = results['2021'] < results['2018']; if (isLowerThan2019 && isLowerThan2018) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
